hero.name: Ray Torres
hero.title: Full-Stack Engineer
hero.subtitle: Backend (Laravel, Go) & Mobile (Flutter)
hero.description: I lead production systems end to end, from architecture to deployment, as the sole technical owner. My work runs across government platforms, permit systems, and document management tools that handle real municipal operations, integrated with payment gateways, banking APIs, and external teams where production errors are not an option.

items.name: Digital Signature Platform
items.description: Sole backend architect of a multi-tenant SaaS platform where each organization acts as its own certificate authority and signs for its departments and staff. I built all 7 microservices: identity, HSM key custody, X.509 issuance, PAdES signing, verification, audit and an API gateway. Hexagonal ports keep SoftHSM and freeTSA swappable for a cloud HSM and certified TSA. Backend v1 complete, in sandbox pending rollout.

items.name: Bitácora Digital
items.description: Mobile and web system used to supervise public and private construction projects. Inspectors and supervisors use the platform to track project progress, register site visits, and document compliance in real time. I led the full architectural refactor, rebuilding the Flutter app and the Laravel + Firebase backend while keeping the live platform running for its existing users. The refactored version is in staging, ready for production rollout.

items.name: Ventanilla Virtual Guanajuato
items.description: Construction permit platform serving nearly 10,000 users, with 53,446 licenses processed and $42.6M MXN in state revenue collected over 5 years in production. I coordinated the payment integration with CapitalNet, synchronizing billing and confirmation flows via webhooks. My role evolved from development into direct technical coordination with state stakeholders: communication, incident tracking, and directing the engineering team.

items.name: LicenciasZac
items.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform managing membership and licensing for 4 professional associations across Zacatecas; engineers, architects, mechanical-electrical engineers, and restoration architects. Handles document generation, member dues, credential renewals, and full data isolation per organization. Built end to end. $12.1M MXN in membership dues collected through the platform since launch.

items.name: CICZAC - Colegio de Ingenieros Civiles de Zacatecas
items.description: Emergency rebuild of a third-party system for a professional association: member records, document uploads, and verification of government IDs and certificates. The system had security debt, 777 permissions on directories with identity documents, plaintext passwords, SQL injection risks. I redesigned the schema, added authentication and file permissions, and migrated all users and documents without data loss, analysis to production in 3 days.

items.name: Celaya Construction Permit System
items.description: Production platform used daily by the Municipality of Celaya to manage construction and urban development permits, 632 users, 10,666 licenses processed, and $66.6M MXN in municipal revenue channeled over 5 years. I built the REST APIs in PHP and MySQL and integrated them with the AngularJS frontend. I also coordinated the integration of BanBajio's payment gateway and the synchronization of records with the municipal finance database.

items.name: Licencias Guadalupe
items.description: Municipal platform for managing construction and urban development permits in Guadalupe, Zacatecas. I led the development of the full system, backend, data model, and frontend integration.

items.name: Permisos Capital de Zacatecas
items.description: Construction permit platform for the capital municipality of Zacatecas. I coordinated three systems: the municipality's cost catalog, BBVA's payment gateway, and a digital signature API for permit authorization. This meant keeping data integrity across the platform, finance database, and signature system at once. The platform is offline after a change in municipal administration, common when local governments transition their infrastructure.

items.name: Adoptable
items.description: Mobile app designed to simplify pet adoption by connecting shelters and adopters in a single platform. Built with clean architecture and BLoC. Complete MVP available as a showcase on GitHub.

items.name: BankMaster
items.description: Mobile application for managing sports betting operations, including users, bets, and financial tracking. Built the Flutter app and Laravel backend end to end, from architecture to Google Play deployment, including localization (l10n) and subscription management with RevenueCat.
